# Public-company scan sample: Apple Inc.

**Prepared:** 2026-11-13  
**Evidence cutoff:** Apple FY2026 Form 10-K, filed in November 2026  
**Scope:** Descriptive summary of selected company disclosures. This is not investment, legal, or accounting advice.

## What the filing reports

- Apple reported FY2026 net sales of **$478.8 billion**, up **15%** from $416.2 billion in FY2025. The filing attributes the increase primarily to higher iPhone net sales.
- Services net sales were **$123.3 billion**, up **13%** from $109.2 billion. Apple attributes that increase primarily to advertising and cloud services.
- Research and development expense was **$45.8 billion**, up **32%**. Apple attributes the increase primarily to infrastructure-related costs, including AI investments, and headcount-related expenses.

These are company-reported amounts and attributions. The scan does not independently validate management's explanations or infer future performance.

## Read-through and limits

The reported growth rates show that both the device business and Services expanded in FY2026, while R&D rose faster than sales. This is a filing-level observation, not a market-share estimate or evidence that any named competitor gained or lost share.

**Not checked:** competitor filings, total addressable market, channel checks, product-level unit volume, forward estimates, and any non-public information. A full engagement must state the sector and comparison set, cite every material claim, and separate company disclosures from analyst inference.

## Source

[Apple Inc., FY2026 Form 10-K, filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019326000026/aapl-20260926.htm), read 2026-11-13. Relevant sections: Products and Services Performance (filing pp. 25–26), Research and Development (p. 27).
